search.query:
index="wineventlog" EventCode=4625
| stats count, min(_time) as first_attempt, max(_time) as last_attempt by TargetUserName, IpAddress
| eval first_attempt=strftime(first_attempt, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), last_attempt=strftime(last_attempt, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
| sort - count

index="wineventlog" EventCode=4624 (LogonType=2 OR LogonType=11 OR LogonType=10)
| search NOT (TargetUserName="*$*" OR TargetUserName="SYSTEM" OR TargetUserName="DWM-*" OR TargetUserName="UMFD-*")
| table _time, TargetUserName, LogonType, IpAddress

index="wineventlog" (EventCode=4720 OR EventCode=4728 OR EventCode=4732 OR EventCode=4722 OR EventCode=4724)
| table _time, host, EventCode, SubjectUserName, TargetUserName, MemberName
| sort -_time

index="wineventlog" sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog" source="*Sysmon/Operational" EventCode=1
| search "encoded" OR "base64" OR "-enc" OR "iex" OR "DownloadString" OR "WebClient" OR "Invoke-Shellcode" OR "Net.WebClient" OR "Reflection.Assembly" OR "BitTransfer"
| table _time, host, User, Image, CommandLine
| sort -_time

index="wineventlog" source="*Sysmon/Operational" EventCode=1
NOT (Image="*\\splunk*" OR ParentImage="*\\splunk*" OR Image="*\\vmtoolsd.exe" OR ParentImage="*\\vmtoolsd.exe")
| table _time, User, Image, ParentImage, CommandLine
| sort -_time

index="wineventlog" (EventCode=4698 OR EventCode=4702)
| xmlkv
| where NOT (Command LIKE "%usoclient.exe%")
| table _time, host, TaskName, Command
| sort -_time

index="wineventlog" EventCode=4769 TicketEncryptionType="0x17"
| table _time, TargetUserName, ServiceName, TicketEncryptionType, IpAddress
| sort -_time

index="wineventlog" source="*Sysmon/Operational" EventCode=3 (DestinationPort=445 OR DestinationPort=135 OR DestinationPort=5985)
| table _time, User, Image, SourceIp, DestinationIp, DestinationPort
| sort -_time
